subject.title: Feature request: configurable lane wait diagnostic threshold

question: Should OpenClaw accept `diagnostics.laneWaitWarnMs` as a public diagnostics config key, and should it hot-apply to future queue entries or require a restart?
rationale: The log-noise problem is source-confirmed, but adding a new public config key is compatibility-sensitive and an open PR already owns the implementation path.

options.title: Accept hot-applied diagnostics key
options.body: Land or replace the linked PR after schema, types, help/reference docs, tests, and reload planning all agree on a future-entry hot-apply contract.

options.title: Accept restart-only setting
options.body: Keep the config key but document and test restart-required semantics instead of promising reload behavior.

options.title: Decline the config knob
options.body: Keep the threshold fixed or solve log noise through broader diagnostics policy, then close or redirect the linked implementation path.

recommendation.title: Accept hot-applied diagnostics key
recommendation.body: Land or replace the linked PR after schema, types, help/reference docs, tests, and reload planning all agree on a future-entry hot-apply contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combination of queue feature history and issue-specific guidance on the desired config/docs/test shape.
